_meta.rationale: Optional per-service overrides for the auto-discovered service list. Absent file or absent entry → default behavior (auto-restart at DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 300s). Entries here tighten thresholds or change restart strategy for hot services. Keys MUST match the exact unit-name shape returned by list_ourliberty_services() in scripts/heal_stale_daemon_code.py (i.e. include the `.service` suffix). `restart_strategy` ∈ {auto, dm-only, never}; unrecognized values fall back to `auto`.
